name: Media Organizer 1.5.3
body:
**Installed-app acceptance release.** This version was installed silently on a real machine and driven end-to-end through Windows UIAutomation: folder picking, nested Year → Quarter → Month strategy, live plan, organize (23 files into 15 folders, duplicates skipped, uncertain set aside), clean exit, Start Menu shortcut and uninstaller verified.

Also: strategy cards are now keyboard- and screen-reader-accessible (Tab + Space to select, full UIAutomation support).

183 automated tests + 131 QA scenario checks, all passing.

Download **MediaOrganizer-Setup-1.5.3.exe** below.
